headline: Crossings are dramatic but unpredictable; calving delivers consistent action
summary: River crossings are the migration's most famous spectacle but require luck, patience, and strategic positioning. Calving season (January-March) delivers 8,000+ births daily at peak with reliable predator action as big cats hunt vulnerable newborns. Crossings are a lottery; calving is a guarantee. The choice depends on whether you prefer drama with uncertainty or reliable intensity.

assumptions.text: River crossings cannot be scheduled or guaranteed regardless of positioning.
Calving season delivers consistent wildlife action daily during peak weeks.
Predator density and hunting success are highest during calving.

gains: Crossings: Iconic, dramatic footage opportunity if witnessed
Crossings: Crocodile action adds predator dimension
Calving: 8,000+ births daily at peak; action is constant
Calving: Predator hunting most reliable of any season

Crossings: Short trips may miss entirely
